/* {{pp-template}} */
.mw-tmpl-kbd {
	background: #EEE;
	color: var(--color-base);
}


@media screen {
    html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .mw-tmpl-kbd {
		background: #171a1d;
	}
}


@media screen and (  prefers-color-scheme: dark ) {
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .mw-tmpl-kbd {
		background: #171a1d;
	}
}
